faqs.a:
The city manager shall, from time-to-time, prepare an organization chart and transmit
               said chart to the city council for its approval by resolution. The organization chart
               shall reflect the administrative organization as prescribed by this article and the
               various municipal functions thereof as recommended by the city manager.
(Code 1981, § 2-98; Ord. No. 2065, § 3, 5-21-1984)
